description: ANALYTICS: list publishing results across posts — each row is the outcome of one post on one platform (success/error, native post id & URL). Filter by social_post_id to see how a specific post fared on every target account.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (pagination offset).

social_post_id.description: Filter results to a single social post id.

name: list_post_results
